from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific financial metric extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company from the financial report")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period covered by the report (e.g., '2025 Q1')")
    metric_name: str = Field(description="Name of the cash flow line item as written in the report")
    amount: float = Field(description="Numeric value of the cash flow amount")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency of the amount (e.g., 'CNY', 'Yuan')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flow_records: list[CompanyCashFlowRecord]
